title: fragaria viridis var. umbelliformis
intro: Fragaria viridis var. umbelliformis, commonly known as woodland strawberry, is a variety of wild strawberry native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria viridis var. umbelliformis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-diabetic properties, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal and antioxidant properties.
